alpha_match_source.caveat_age: This official metric reflects the alpha_classifier prompt as it stood at H4's own stated HEAD (8ecf6bfdf7fd8203e223b220be8ca244da92d1f1), which is confirmed (by direct git show) to still carry prompt_version=week2.alpha_classifier.v1 -- i.e. BEFORE the v3 rewrite in commit c454245 that Day 3 identified. This number does not reflect the current prompt any more than the Day 2/3 samples did.

note_on_not_re_deriving: These are the sets' own already-computed, frozen, human-reviewed official metrics -- not re-run today. No denominator or exclusion was altered to reach John's targets. A fresh local-deterministic-only re-derivation (matching Phase A's method) was not performed for these sets in this pass; Phase A already demonstrates that such a re-derivation would test only the always-weak deterministic fallback, not the actual current LLM-backed capability these targets are meant to measure.
why_different_sets: No single independent (non-H5) frozen set in the repository carries both Alpha and Polarity human review at H4's size/rigor; H4 is Alpha-only, H2 is the only other independent set with both dimensions.
